references.text: The same command to keep God's laws and statutes, with the promise of life for those who do so
Repetition of the command to keep all of God's statutes and laws and to follow them
The same wording about keeping God's commands and following them
Moses urges Israel to keep the statutes and laws that the Lord has commanded
Command to teach and keep the Lord's laws and statutes
The Lord's commands, statutes, and laws are to be kept all days
Israel's obligation to keep the Lord's statutes, commands, and laws
God's promise to give his Spirit so that the people will keep his laws and statutes
Jesus commands the disciples to teach the nations to keep everything he has commanded them
Jesus says that whoever loves him keeps his commands
Keeping Jesus' commands as an expression of love, just as Jesus kept the Father's commands
Love for God is shown by keeping his commands, and his commands are not burdensome
